data.coco_dataset_generator module

This script iterates through a directory tree, finds image files, and parses corresponding custom JSON or Pascal VOC XML annotation files to build a single COCO-compliant JSON file. It handles robust category mapping and provides a detailed summary of processed and skipped files.

data.coco_dataset_generator.generate_coco_json(root_dir: str, output_path: str)[source]

Main function to scan the directory tree, parse annotations, and save the COCO JSON file.

Parameters:

  • root_dir (str) – The root directory containing the images and their annotations.

  • output_path (str) – The path where the final COCO JSON file will be saved.

data.coco_dataset_generator.get_category_id_robust(raw_cname: str) → int[source]

Looks up category ID robustly using a case-insensitive, stripped key. If the category name is not found, the annotation is assigned to the ‘trash’ category (TRASH_CATEGORY_ID) and the global reassignment counter is updated.

Parameters:

raw_cname (str) – The raw category name extracted from the annotation file.

Returns:

The integer category ID (e.g., 1, 2, 5).

Return type:

int

data.coco_dataset_generator.get_image_dimensions(image_path: str) → Tuple[int, int] | None[source]

Reads image dimensions safely using the PIL library.

Parameters:

image_path (str) – Path to the image file.

Returns:

A tuple containing (width, height) in pixels, or None if the file is invalid.

Return type:

Optional[Tuple[int, int]]

data.coco_dataset_generator.parse_custom_json(json_path: str, image_id: int, image_width: int, image_height: int, ann_id: int) → Tuple[List[Dict], int][source]

Parses custom JSON annotation format (assuming normalized coordinates [0, 1]).

Parameters:

  • json_path (str) – Path to the custom JSON annotation file.

  • image_id (int) – The COCO ID of the image currently being processed.

  • image_width (int) – Image width in pixels, used for coordinate conversion.

  • image_height (int) – Image height in pixels, used for coordinate conversion.

  • ann_id (int) – The starting annotation ID counter.

Returns:

A tuple containing the list of new COCO annotations and the updated annotation ID.

Return type:

Tuple[List[Dict], int]

Parses Pascal VOC XML annotation format (assuming absolute pixel coordinates).

Parameters:

  • xml_path (str) – Path to the Pascal VOC XML file.

  • image_id (int) – The COCO ID of the image currently being processed.

  • ann_id (int) – The starting annotation ID counter.

Returns:

A tuple containing the list of new COCO annotations and the updated annotation ID.

Tuple[List[Dict], int]
